phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrates a capacitive sensing electrode, a microcontroller unit (MCU), and wireless communication radio in a compact, environmentally protected assembly designed to measure volumetric water content in soil and transmit data remotely.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification captures the dominant industry design as of 2024-2025 for soil moisture sensors with embedded intelligence and radio telemetry, which are widely used in precision agriculture to provide real-time soil moisture data via capacitive sensing (non-corrosive, long-lasting) coupled with on-board MCU processing and radio communications (often LoRa, Zigbee, or BLE). These integrated devices replace older resistive sensors for better durability and wireless capability.
